stemMd: The economist endorsed the proposal only if safeguards were added; her support was therefore ______.
explanationMd: Only if introduces a necessary condition for support. Conditional accurately captures that limitation; the sentence does not say she opposes the proposal under every circumstance.

distractorRationale.d: A single person's position cannot establish unanimity.
distractorRationale.b: The explicit safeguard requirement limits endorsement.
